audit.whatIsWrong: Row 0 read Skill while whys[0] says 'Level 1 favours you', and row 6 read Skill while whys[6] says '2+ items favours Poppy'. The packet chart is Urgot x6 then Poppy.
audit.why: Full-tank Poppy with a dash-stopping W, a wall stun and Keeper's Verdict is a teamfight peeler the Urgot execute stops reaching — that is a Poppy row, not a coin flip, and every prose paragraph on the page already says so.
audit.corrected: Row 0 = Urgot at 6/10, row 6 = Poppy at 3/10, both proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text says 'R Fear Beyond Death flips a Poppy who E Heroic Charges you into a wall'. Fear Beyond Death does not flip — it impales and executes. Disdain (E) is the flip.
audit.why: Two different abilities were merged into one. It also missed the real level-6 payoff against Poppy specifically.
audit.corrected: Fear Beyond Death (100s at rank 1) punishes the wall pin AND cancels Keeper's Verdict, which Riot's kit lists as a channel — an interrupted Verdict is the biggest single swing available to you in this matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page states the exact opposite of the truth in two places: spikes[0].text says Steadfast Presence 'only blocks dashes and does nothing to your ranged shred', and early says it 'only matters against dash champs, which you aren't'.
audit.why: Disdain (E) is a charge — Riot's text: 'Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies.' Steadfast Presence (W, 20s at rank 1 falling to 12s) stops enemy dashes around her and slows and grounds whoever it stops. She can therefore eat your only engage and your only escape, and ground you afterwards. A player following the current advice walks into the single worst outcome available in this lane.
audit.corrected: Never open with the flip. Bait Steadfast Presence (20s at rank 1) first, then Disdain. Heroic Charge (E) is 14s at rank 1 and only stuns into terrain, so fight away from walls. Iron Ambassador (P) gives her a shield when she retrieves the buckler — force it out before you commit.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero sequencing cues; breakdown.cooldowns named both abilities but gave no numbers and did not say what Steadfast Presence does to you.
audit.why: 14s E and 20s W are the two clocks, and the W is the one that decides whether your engage exists.
audit.corrected: Both numbers stated, with the instruction to bait the W before flipping.

notes: This was the most dangerous entry in my slice. Two strings told the reader that Poppy's Steadfast Presence does not matter because Urgot is not a dash champion. Disdain is a charge, Steadfast Presence stops charges and grounds what it stops, and Disdain is simultaneously Urgot's only engage and only escape — so following the old advice hands her the fight. The full-layer cooldown block already had the W described correctly, which means the content layer and the full layer were contradicting each other on the same page. The packet's suspectName hit on 'Heroic Charges' is a false positive: that is the real ability name used as a verb. The real error in that string was calling Fear Beyond Death a flip.
